verdict.rationale: The evidence shows vLLM's source is publicly hosted on GitHub (github.com/vllm-project/vllm) and can be built from source for development. Community comments also refer directly to vLLM's codebase, so readable source is well supported. The pack never names an open-source license, so the "under an open license" half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g. Apache-2.0 or another OSI license), first-party statement of open-source licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Or build from source for development.
Systems like vLLM's codebase are massive and hard to follow.
